name: ANSI three-way switch plan symbol
summary: US plan symbol S3 for a three-way switch, used in pairs to control lights from two locations.
description: The US three-way switch is drawn as S with subscript 3. Two S3 symbols appear on the plan at different entries, connected by switch legs to the same lighting group, and the installer runs travellers between them.

Despite the name, a three-way switch has a single changeover contact. The name refers to its three terminals. The equivalent IEC term is a two-way switch. The symbol does not show traveller routing or box fill; the installer plans this from the pair.
readingNotes: Look for S4 symbols between them on long runs.
drawingChecklist: Allow for travellers in conduit fill.
distinction: S4 is a four-way intermediate device; S3 is the changeover switch used at the ends.
